audience: hotel and hospitality teams that manage guest profiles, reservations and loyalty in Bookboost

useCases.title: Find a guest and check their contact details
useCases.text: Search guest profiles by email, phone or booking reference. Open one profile to read its stored emails and phone numbers.

useCases.title: Check a guest's loyalty memberships
useCases.text: List the loyalty memberships of one guest, with level and expiry. Read the loyalty program to see its levels.

useCases.title: Review reservations for a stay period
useCases.text: List reservations by stay dates or last update. Open one reservation to read its dates, status and party size.

useCases.title: Update the status or dates of a reservation
useCases.text: Change the status, dates or party size of one reservation. Only the fields you give are changed.

useCases.title: Add a new guest profile
useCases.text: Create a guest profile with a primary email and phone. Bookboost may reject an email that already exists.
